conflicts.topic: 2026 XPLOR fork spring rates printed about 10x too high
conflicts.spread: 2026 manuals print 40-52 N/mm (with matching lbf/in), while 2024-2025 manuals print 4.2-5.0 N/mm for the same forks
conflicts.note: Probably a decimal error in the 2026 manuals; recorded as printed. Check before using.
1,890 mm is not plausible for this chassis; probably a manual error.

conflicts.topic: 2025 125 XC fork listed with 5 bar air pressure
conflicts.spread: XPLOR CC listed at 'Air pressure 5 bar (73 psi)', and no spring rate is given
conflicts.note: Other XPLOR CC tables list coil springs. Recorded as printed.
